title: Trump Tower
visualBrief: Complete Fifth Avenue bronze-glass sawtooth tower, six setback roofs, five planted upper terraces and mapped recessed entrance.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +X along the mapped building long axis
nativeAxes.origin: Ground-level center of exact-QID mapped footprint frame

appearance.identity: Bronze-glass angular sawtooth shaft with stepped planted southwestern corner and monumental Fifth Avenue portal.
appearance.scope: Whole medium-fi exterior preserves the seven mapped footprints,202.4m sawtooth shaft, six stepped roofs and five upper planted terraces. Original19067-triangle recipe remains reproducible in Git. Reviewed source moves its five previously floating planters onto their corresponding mapped roof strips and replaces repeated storefront slabs at the independently mapped main entry with an original recessed bronze/gold portal. Entrance dimensions, glazing panels, concave spandrels, planting species and exact present hardware are reconstructed. CTBUH202.4m/58physical floors differs from owner marketing68; completion dates differ across owner1983/1984 and CTBUH1982 and are left attributed rather than invented into geometry. Owner brochure2019 plans and exterior photographs establish entrance/sawtooth identity, not a current hardware survey. Skyline keeps full silhouette with graph-mean colors; district simplifies vertical bars and combines spandrel rows; street keeps full bay strips; closeup keeps original concave spandrels and planted forms. Zero embedded images; canonical shared surfaces only. Interiors, branding, separate adjoining East57th public terrace, street clock and temporary security barriers are outside this exterior asset. Ground grade, night rendering and physical-device timing remain unmeasured.
